propositions: serverInfo 200 response is insufficient as a readiness gate; it does not guarantee that plugin-provided custom fields are registered

a timing flake occurs when serverInfo returns 200 but required GreenHopper fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) are not yet in the field inventory, causing failures to be misdiagnosed as image degradation rather than initialization lag
the harness and probe workflows currently define readiness differently (harness polls serverInfo only; probe polls field inventory), creating drift that violates the declared shared contract
a system-only field inventory (zero customfield_* entries) must be treated as NOT-READY, not as a degraded image, and must be distinguished from a genuine image degrade

the readiness definition must be centralized in one shared module so both tiers cannot diverge and the field-inventory check must have its own bounded budget with self-diagnosing failure output that quotes the observed inventory
